crossRefs.note: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that…
Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.
In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of…

parallels.note: For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

translations.web: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.
translations.bsb: A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit.
translations.kjv: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
translations.asv: A good tree cannot bring forth evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
